backpack.name: Backpack
backpack.description: A leather backpack with straps and buckles. Can hold up to 400 gp of weight.

grappling_hook.name: Grappling Hook
grappling_hook.description: An iron hook with multiple prongs for securing ropes.

crowbar.name: Crowbar
crowbar.description: An iron bar for prying open doors or containers. +2 bonus to force doors.

hammer.name: Hammer
hammer.description: A small hammer for driving spikes and pitons.

piton.name: Iron Spike/Piton
piton.description: An iron spike for securing ropes or wedging doors.

torch.name: Torch
torch.description: A wooden stick wrapped in oil-soaked cloth. Burns for 1 hour (6 turns).

lantern_hooded.name: Lantern, Hooded
lantern_hooded.description: An oil-burning lantern with a hood. Burns for 4 hours per flask of oil.

lantern_bullseye.name: Lantern, Bullseye
lantern_bullseye.description: A directional lantern with focused beam. Burns for 4 hours per flask of oil.

oil_flask.name: Oil, Flask (1 pint)
oil_flask.description: A flask of lamp oil. Burns for 4 hours in a lantern. Can be used as a weapon (thrown, 1d8 fire damage if lit).

waterskin.name: Waterskin
waterskin.description: A leather skin for carrying water or wine. Holds 1 quart when full.

sack_small.name: Sack, Small
sack_small.description: A small cloth or leather sack. Can hold up to 200 gp of weight.

sack_large.name: Sack, Large
sack_large.description: A large cloth or leather sack. Can hold up to 600 gp of weight.

chest.name: Chest
chest.description: A wooden chest with iron bands and a lock.

pouch_belt.name: Pouch, Belt
pouch_belt.description: A small leather pouch worn on the belt. Can hold up to 50 gp of weight.

rations_standard.name: Rations, Standard (per day)
rations_standard.description: One day's worth of preserved food (dried meat, hard bread, cheese).

rations_iron.name: Rations, Iron (per day)
rations_iron.description: One day's worth of dried rations. Lasts 3 months without spoiling.

trail_rations.name: Trail Rations (per week)
trail_rations.description: One week's worth of trail rations for wilderness travel.

ale_quart.name: Ale (per quart)
ale_quart.description: A quart of common ale or beer.

clothing_common.name: Clothing, Common
clothing_common.description: A set of common clothes (tunic, breeches, simple shoes).

clothing_fine.name: Clothing, Fine
clothing_fine.description: A set of fine clothes suitable for nobility.

boots.name: Boots
boots.description: A sturdy pair of leather boots.

boots_riding.name: Boots, Riding
boots_riding.description: High leather boots designed for riding.

thieves_tools.name: Thieves' Tools
thieves_tools.description: A set of lockpicks, files, and other tools for thiefwork. Required for picking locks and disarming traps.

healers_kit.name: Healer's Kit
healers_kit.description: Bandages, herbs, and medical tools. Grants +2 bonus to healing checks.

mining_pick.name: Mining Pick
mining_pick.description: A heavy iron pick for mining and digging through stone.

shovel.name: Shovel
shovel.description: A wooden-handled shovel with iron blade.

holy_symbol_wood.name: Holy Symbol, Wooden
holy_symbol_wood.description: A wooden holy symbol. Required for clerics to turn undead.

holy_symbol_silver.name: Holy Symbol, Silver
holy_symbol_silver.description: A silver holy symbol. Required for clerics to turn undead.

holy_water.name: Holy Water, Vial
holy_water.description: A vial of blessed water. Deals 2d4 damage to undead when thrown.

mirror_small.name: Mirror, Small Steel
mirror_small.description: A small polished steel mirror. Useful for seeing around corners or detecting certain monsters.

pole_10ft.name: Pole, 10 feet
pole_10ft.description: A 10-foot wooden pole. Useful for probing for traps or testing floors.

chain_10ft.name: Chain, 10 feet
chain_10ft.description: 10 feet of iron chain. Stronger than rope.

lock_good.name: Lock, Good
lock_good.description: A high-quality lock with key. Difficult to pick (-10% to thief skill).

lock_poor.name: Lock, Poor
lock_poor.description: A simple lock with key. Easy to pick (+10% to thief skill).

manacles.name: Manacles
manacles.description: Iron shackles with a lock. Used to restrain prisoners.

candle.name: Candle
candle.description: A wax candle. Burns for 1 hour. Provides dim light.

chalk.name: Chalk
chalk.description: A piece of chalk for marking walls and doors.

parchment.name: Parchment (per sheet)
parchment.description: A sheet of parchment for writing.

ink_vial.name: Ink, Vial
ink_vial.description: A vial of black ink for writing.

spellbook_blank.name: Spellbook, Blank
spellbook_blank.description: A blank spellbook with 100 pages. Required for magic-users to record spells.

scroll_case.name: Scroll Case
scroll_case.description: A leather or wooden tube for storing scrolls and maps.

bedroll.name: Bedroll
bedroll.description: A blanket and sleeping mat rolled together.

tinderbox.name: Tinderbox (flint & steel)
tinderbox.description: Flint, steel, and tinder for starting fires.

whetstone.name: Whetstone
whetstone.description: A stone for sharpening bladed weapons.

fishing_net_25ft.name: Fishing Net, 25 sq. ft.
fishing_net_25ft.description: A fishing net, 5 feet by 5 feet.

barrel.name: Barrel
barrel.description: A wooden barrel for storing liquids or goods. Holds 40 gallons.

bottle_glass.name: Bottle, Glass
bottle_glass.description: A glass bottle with a cork stopper.

horn_signal.name: Signal Horn
horn_signal.description: A horn for signaling. Can be heard up to 1 mile away.

wolfsbane.name: Wolfsbane (bunch)
wolfsbane.description: A bunch of wolfsbane herb. Repels lycanthropes.

garlic.name: Garlic (bunch)
garlic.description: A bunch of garlic. Repels vampires.

horse_riding.name: Horse, Riding
horse_riding.description: A standard riding horse. Movement 24", can carry up to 3000 gp weight.

horse_war.name: Horse, War (Heavy)
horse_war.description: A heavy warhorse trained for combat. Movement 18", can carry up to 4000 gp weight.

pony.name: Pony
pony.description: A small pony. Movement 12", can carry up to 2000 gp weight.

mule.name: Mule
mule.description: A pack mule. Movement 12", can carry up to 2000 gp weight.

cart.name: Cart
cart.description: A two-wheeled cart. Requires horse or mule to pull. Can carry up to 4000 gp weight.

wagon.name: Wagon
wagon.description: A four-wheeled wagon. Requires 2 horses or 4 mules to pull. Can carry up to 15000 gp weight.

boots_levitation.name: Boots of Levitation
boots_levitation.description: Enchanted boots that allow the wearer to levitate at will, rising or descending up to 20 feet per round.

amulet_waterbreathing.name: Amulet of Waterbreathing
amulet_waterbreathing.description: A magical amulet that allows the wearer to breathe underwater indefinitely.

serpents_fang.name: The Serpent's Fang
serpents_fang.description: A crystallized serpent fang pulsing with dark energy. Said to be a fragment of the Serpent God's power.

legendary_weapon_choice.name: Legendary Weapon (Player's Choice)
legendary_weapon_choice.description: A token representing the player's choice of one legendary weapon as a reward for completing the campaign.

first_key.name: First Key of the Serpent
first_key.description: An ornate key bearing the serpent symbol, obtained from completing Episode 1.

second_key.name: Second Key of the Serpent
second_key.description: An ornate key bearing the serpent symbol, obtained from completing Episode 2.

third_key.name: Third Key of the Serpent
third_key.description: An ornate key bearing the serpent symbol, obtained from completing Episode 3.

fourth_key.name: Fourth Key of the Serpent
fourth_key.description: An ornate key bearing the serpent symbol, obtained from completing Episode 4.

fifth_key.name: Fifth Key of the Serpent
fifth_key.description: An ornate key bearing the serpent symbol, obtained from completing Episode 5.

sixth_key.name: Sixth Key of the Serpent
sixth_key.description: An ornate key bearing the serpent symbol, obtained from completing Episode 6.

seventh_key.name: Seventh Key of the Serpent
seventh_key.description: An ornate key bearing the serpent symbol, obtained from completing Episode 7.

eighth_key.name: Eighth Key of the Serpent
eighth_key.description: An ornate key bearing the serpent symbol, obtained from completing Episode 8.

ninth_key.name: Ninth Key of the Serpent
ninth_key.description: An ornate key bearing the serpent symbol, obtained from completing Episode 9.

tenth_key.name: Tenth Key of the Serpent
tenth_key.description: The final key bearing the serpent symbol, obtained from completing Episode 10.

serpent_eye_medallion.name: Serpent Eye Medallion
serpent_eye_medallion.description: A medallion worn by members of the Serpent Eye cult, proving their allegiance.

kranes_journal.name: Krane's Journal
kranes_journal.description: The personal journal of Valerius Krane, detailing his dark plans and the cult's hierarchy.

ritual_notes.name: Ritual Notes
ritual_notes.description: Detailed notes describing the cult's dark rituals and summoning procedures.

serpent_slayer_title_scroll.name: Scroll of the Serpent Slayer
serpent_slayer_title_scroll.description: An official proclamation granting the bearer the title 'Serpent Slayer' for defeating the cult and saving the realm.

serpent_slayer_title.name: Title: Serpent Slayer
serpent_slayer_title.description: The prestigious title 'Serpent Slayer' has been bestowed upon you for defeating the Serpent Eye cult and saving the realm from darkness.

healing_potion.name: Potion of Healing
healing_potion.description: A red liquid in a glass vial. Drinking this potion heals 2d4+2 hit points.

bolts.name: Crossbow Bolts (20)
bolts.description: A quiver of 20 iron-tipped crossbow bolts.

gold_coins.name: Gold Coins
gold_coins.description: A pile of gold coins. Value varies.

rat_pelt.name: Giant Rat Pelt
rat_pelt.description: The pelt of a giant rat. Has minimal value but can be sold.

waterlogged_journal.name: Waterlogged Journal
waterlogged_journal.description: A badly water-damaged journal belonging to a long-dead adventurer. Describes the sewers and mentions 'something lurking in the deep water.'

guard_schedule.name: Guard Rotation Schedule
guard_schedule.description: A parchment detailing the cultist guard rotations and patrol routes throughout the sewers.

cult_scripture.name: Cult Scripture
cult_scripture.description: Religious texts of the Serpent Eye cult, describing their beliefs about 'the awakening' and the power of the Serpent.

ritual_scroll.name: Ritual Scroll
ritual_scroll.description: A scroll describing a dark ritual for summoning serpentine entities.

quill_and_ink.name: Quill and Ink
quill_and_ink.description: A feather quill and ink pot for writing.

prayer_beads.name: Serpent Prayer Beads
prayer_beads.description: Prayer beads carved with serpent symbols, used by cultists during meditation.

emerald_eyes.name: Emerald Serpent Eyes
emerald_eyes.description: Two large emeralds carved to resemble serpent eyes, taken from a cult statue. Extremely valuable.

gold_chalice.name: Gold Chalice
gold_chalice.description: An ornate gold chalice used in cult rituals. Bears serpent engravings.

mysterious_key.name: Mysterious Serpent Key
mysterious_key.description: An unusual key found in the hidden shrine. Its purpose is unclear, but it bears the serpent symbol.

cultist_roster.name: Cultist Roster
cultist_roster.description: A list of cult members' names and ranks. Many names are recognizable as Oakhaven citizens.

merchant_ledger.name: The Merchant's Ledger
merchant_ledger.description: A ledger tracking shipments from 'The Merchant' (Silas) to the cult. Records weapons, supplies, and ritual components.

torture_notes.name: Torture Documentation
torture_notes.description: Disturbing notes detailing interrogation techniques and results. Lists prisoners and what information was extracted.

incense.name: Ritual Incense
incense.description: Strange-smelling incense used in cult rituals. Burns with an acrid, green smoke.

merchant_letters.name: Letters from The Merchant
merchant_letters.description: Correspondence between the cult leader and 'The Merchant.' Discusses 'the awakening,' gathering sacrifices, and 'the ten keys.'

regional_map.name: Marked Regional Map
regional_map.description: A map of the region marked with serpent symbols at various locations. Shows cult activity extending far beyond Oakhaven.

serpent_idol.name: Serpent Idol
serpent_idol.description: A small statue of a coiled serpent with ruby eyes. Used in cult devotions.

ceremonial_dagger.name: Ceremonial Serpent Dagger
ceremonial_dagger.description: An ornate dagger with a serpent-shaped hilt. Used in cult blood rituals, but functions as a weapon.

iron_chains.name: Iron Chains
iron_chains.description: Heavy iron chains used to restrain prisoners.

iron_spikes.name: Iron Spikes (12)
iron_spikes.description: A dozen iron spikes for securing ropes or wedging doors.

rations.name: Standard Rations (1 day)
rations.description: One day's worth of preserved food - bread, dried meat, cheese.

ritual_scroll_darkness.name: Ritual Scroll: Darkness
ritual_scroll_darkness.description: A dark ritual scroll that can cast the 'Darkness' spell once when read.

spell_scroll_cure_light_wounds.name: Spell Scroll: Cure Light Wounds
spell_scroll_cure_light_wounds.description: A divine scroll that can cast 'Cure Light Wounds' once when read by a cleric.

serpent_robes.name: Serpent Eye Robes
serpent_robes.description: Hooded robes worn by Serpent Eye cultists, embroidered with serpent symbols. Could be used as a disguise.

ritual_dagger.name: Ritual Dagger
ritual_dagger.description: A simple dagger used in blood sacrifices. Bloodstained but functional.

cult_documents.name: Cult Documents
cult_documents.description: A collection of letters, maps, and documents detailing the cult's structure, goals, and connections to larger conspiracy.

cell_key.name: Prison Cell Key
cell_key.description: An iron key that opens the prison cells where the captives are held.

holy_symbol.name: Holy Symbol
holy_symbol.description: A wooden holy symbol blessed by a temple priest. Required for clerics to turn undead and cast some divine spells.

serpent_holy_symbol.name: Serpent Eye Holy Symbol
serpent_holy_symbol.description: A silver serpent eye symbol worn by high-ranking cultists. Radiates malevolence.
